fieldValues.title: A bundle of ideas is presented as one decision
fieldValues.statement: Almost every decision is several decisions at different layers: a principle, a mechanism, a name, a migration, a rollout. Presented together and undifferentiated, the owner can only accept or reject the whole, and agreeing to one thread carries the others in with it. A decision needs to be split by layer and shown in a coherent form, so each part can be decided on its own and in order.
